local.description: Trivial, mechanical steps with no ambiguity: greet, echo, single grep

free.description: Simple single-tool work: read one file, answer a short question

cheap.description: Everyday edits and searches: small code changes, targeted greps, summaries

standard.description: Moderate engineering: several files, tests, debugging a clear failure

strong.description: Hard engineering: multi-file refactors, architecture, ambiguous specs

frontier.description: Frontier reasoning: long-horizon autonomous work where a wrong answer is expensive
